headline: Apple plans October 13 'Welcome Home' event, reportedly partnering with LG on smart home gear
summary: Apple is reportedly partnering with LG on smart home devices including a lock, doorbell, thermostat and camera, and has announced a 'Welcome Home' launch event in New York on October 13th. Outlets expect the event to include a new smart home hub, refreshed Apple TV and HomePod Mini, and possibly a new platform called homeOS.
